entities.summary: Pierre-Joseph Amoreux was a French medical doctor and naturalist. He was the son of Guillaume Amoreux, also a physician and an inventor of surgical devices. He was the librarian at the Faculté de Médecine de Montpellier, in English Medical college of Montpellier. He was the author of many works on medicine, agriculture, botany and natural history.
